baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يريدون كيدا ... هم المكيدون repeats كيد while changing an intended act into the emphatically identified plotters' passive condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Will initiates a stratagem, concealment characterizes its makers, and the repeated root crosses the fa-clause with its roles reversed. The counter-agent is left unnamed, so the ayah foregrounds not who outplots them but their conversion from intending subjects into affected objects.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention supplies the initiating volition whose control the second clause overturns.
Plotting and stratagem supplies the repeated operation that changes grammatical hands across the hinge.
Covering or rejecting truth identifies the plotters as agents whose hidden work is exposed by the reversal.

changed_reading.before: They intend a plot, but a stronger counterplot defeats it.
changed_reading.after: Their intention passes through the ayah's hinge and returns as their own patient-status: the plotters become the plotted-upon without a rival plotter being named.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الذين كفروا is inserted between the two كيد forms, and هم explicitly points to those coverers before المكيدون.
baseline_models.mechanism: A stratagem depends on concealed purpose, but the ayah names its agents by a covering-root and then isolates them with هم. Their attempted concealment therefore becomes the means by which their role is disclosed, while the passive keeps the answering agency concealed.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the hidden layer that the emphatic identification functionally strips away.
Stratagem supplies the covert operation whose practitioners become overtly marked as its objects.
Soliciting another toward an act adds covert social steering, making exposure of the would-be steerers consequential.

changed_reading.before: Those who disbelieve happen also to be plotting.
changed_reading.after: Their truth-covering and covert steering are part of the trap: the ayah exposes the concealed operators while concealing the agency that contains them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same كيد root appears first as the desired operation and finally as a passive plural predicate applied to its initiators.
baseline_models.mechanism: Read at its more physical edge, كيد is forceful handling. يريدون can cast the actors as scouts selecting and working a target; the passive ending then makes those handlers the material being worked, a role exchange sharper than mere failure.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supplies the target-selection phase of the intended operation.
Forceful handling supplies a material action that the passive predicate redirects onto the handlers.

changed_reading.after: They scout and work upon a target, but the syntax recasts the would-be handlers themselves as material already under handling.

context_deltas.mechanism: They wait for a terminating turn to overtake the addressee, but the reply makes waiting reciprocal. This earlier reversal activates يريدون كيدا as a timed ambush whose waiting-space closes around the waiters; المكيدون names those caught inside the delay they selected.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate slowness supplies the patient timing inside their intention.
Stratagem supplies the ambush-like design whose delay becomes reciprocal.
Waiting and watching supplies the plotters' chosen temporal tactic.
The troubling turns of time supply the event they expect to weaponize.
Cutting an extension supplies the terminal outcome for which their ambush waits.
The repeated waiting-root returns their tactic and places both parties in the same temporal field.

structural_cues: 52:30 assigns waiting to them; 52:31 imperatively returns it and includes the speaker among the waiters.
The focus ayah repeats that reciprocal syntax at higher intensity by returning كيد as a passive label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate waiting, time's feared turn, termination, and a reciprocal command; I infer that delay is part of the scheme and becomes its enclosure. The alternative is that waiting merely precedes a distinct, non-temporal plot.

changed_reading.before: The reversal answers a plot at the moment it is made.
changed_reading.after: The plot is a timed ambush, and the earlier reciprocal waiting shows the ambushers already enclosed by the interval they hoped would terminate someone else.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated أم chain tests whether their minds command, whether they are controlling overseers, and whether they possess the unseen and write it down. The focus scheme culminates this attempted seizure of command and authorship; المكيدون demotes the would-be writers of reality into figures written into a passive role.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth supplies the epistemic resistance behind the attempted rival account.
Stratagem supplies the culminating attempt to make their rival account operative.
Command as binding demand supplies the first tested claim to directive authority.
Controlling oversight supplies the tested claim that they stand above and manage the field.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain they presume to possess.
Inscription that fixes judgment or measure supplies their imagined ability to author binding reality.

structural_cues: The repeated أم questions from 52:30 through 52:42 successively deny poetic diagnosis, rational command, self-creation, cosmic creation, control, privileged hearing, economic leverage, and ownership of the unseen.
52:42 retains the same أم frame but shifts from unsupported claims to intended intervention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied claims to command, oversight, unseen access, and binding inscription; I infer that كيد is their practical attempt to enact those failed claims and that the passive reverses authorship. The alternative is a purely hostile plan unrelated to the preceding epistemic claims.

changed_reading.before: They plot against the messenger after making several false claims.
changed_reading.after: Their plot is the practical form of attempted rival authorship, and the passive ending writes the would-be controllers into a role they do not control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context depicts them actually seeing a falling sky-fragment and renaming it a stacked cloud. This activates كفر as an interpretive cover and كيد as strategic relabeling: the filter meant to neutralize evidence becomes the mechanism that traps its users inside a failing account.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supplies the perceptual overlay placed upon what is present.
Stratagem supplies deliberate reframing as a defensive operation rather than mere ignorance.
Vision by eye and insight supplies actual perception, ruling out simple absence of evidence.
A detached fragment supplies the disruptive object their account must domesticate.
Saying or attributing what is not so supplies the active act of misnaming the perceived event.
An ordinary moving cloud supplies the minimizing replacement category.
Layering one thing over another supplies the very covering structure of their explanation.

structural_cues: 52:44 grants sight but immediately records a verbal relabeling, so seeing and denial coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, a seen fragment, false attribution, and a layered cloud; I infer that interpretive relabeling is a form of كيد and that its cover traps the relabelers. A live alternative is that 52:44 merely illustrates disbelief after the plot has already failed.

changed_reading.before: The unbelievers secretly plan an external hostile act.
changed_reading.after: Their scheme also operates as an internal optics-management system: it covers disruptive evidence with a familiar label until the cover itself encloses them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel gives the passive verdict a temporal unfolding: they meet an appointed severe day, their own كيد provides no sufficiency at all, and no aid arrives. المكيدون thus anticipates not only reversal but the exhaustion of the scheme as a usable resource.

activation_trace.role: Stratagem supplies the focus resource whose apparent efficacy is reversed.
What a person encounters of good or harm supplies the destined meeting into which the verdict unfolds.
A day's occurring severity supplies the appointed terminal horizon of the scheme.
Sufficiency supplies the capacity explicitly denied to their plot.
Their own stratagem reappears as the named resource that cannot accomplish anything for them.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the external support also withheld.

structural_cues: 52:45-46 follows the focus verdict with meeting, appointed time, total non-sufficiency, and absent aid.
The possessive كيدهم in 52:46 confirms that the resource exhausted is their own intended كيد from 52:42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed encounter, their scheme's zero sufficiency, and absent aid; I infer that المكيدون is an anticipatory status whose consequence matures in 52:46. The live alternative is that 52:46 describes a later independent failure rather than unpacking the passive label.

changed_reading.before: They are counterplotted immediately in the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: The focus names their status in advance; its temporal content matures when their own scheme is present but functionally empty and unsupported.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next instruction opposes their will to the addressee's restraint under sovereign judgment and watchful care. This does not grammatically identify the omitted agent of المكيدون, but it relocates the passive inside governance and sight: their unseen maneuver is already witnessed, while the addressee need not seize control in reply.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention supplies the plotters' posture of attempted control.
Stratagem supplies their concealed intervention and the passive condition requiring explanation.
Holding the self from panic supplies the non-controlling response set against their urgent intention.
Judgment between parties supplies the governing frame within which the reversal is resolved.
Sovereignty and mastery supplies the authority surrounding the otherwise agentless passive.
The eye of protection and watchfulness supplies prior visibility of the supposedly hidden maneuver.

structural_cues: 52:42 foregrounds their intention but suppresses the counter-agent; 52:48 names sovereign judgment and watchful eyes.
The addressee is commanded to endure rather than manufacture a symmetrical human counterplot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies their will, concealed strategy, restraint, judgment, sovereignty, and watchful care; I infer that the passive is contained by witnessed governance rather than requiring a named tactical opponent. A live alternative is that the omitted agent remains deliberately indeterminate even after 52:48.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified opponent secretly counterplots them.
changed_reading.after: The agentless reversal sits within already watchful judgment: their hidden intervention is seen and contained, while the addressee is freed from answering control with control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context activates the planning branch of دبر as looking toward an affair's consequence, alongside its sense of the thing's end. Read back into the focus, المكيدون is an afterpart verdict: their scheme is evaluated from the outcome that their intending and scouting failed to include, while appearing and receding stars supply a larger cycle than their chosen horizon.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supplies the planners' forward search for a workable route.
Stratagem supplies the designed maneuver that will be judged by an end beyond its designers' frame.
Planning by looking toward the consequence supplies the criterion their local scheme fails to master.
The end of a thing and passage of its aftermath supplies the retrospective vantage of the passive verdict.
What rises into visibility supplies the cyclical counterpoint to recession and exposes the narrow horizon of the plot.

structural_cues: 52:49 closes the packet with the recession of the stars, placing the focus plot inside a repeated appearing-and-departing horizon.
The دبر inventory lets that temporal ending activate the distinct but coexisting sense of planning by considering consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scouting, stratagem, an afterpart, consequence-aware planning, and visible emergence; I infer that the passive label speaks from the maneuver's aftermath and exposes defective horizon-setting. A live alternative is that 52:49 only schedules praise and contributes no retrospective judgment on the plot.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a counterplot occurring against their present plan.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also speak retrospectively from the plan's afterpart: once its full horizon appears, the would-be planners are seen as objects within an outcome their scouting never encompassed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ر د د mapping under focus يريدون rather than treating it as the word's ordinary lexical sense. It remains anchored by the packet's explicit split mapping, the doubled كيد reversal, and reciprocal waiting. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant structural echo, not as a translation of يريدون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus ر و د secondarily to ر د د, while كيد moves from intended object to passive predicate in the same ayah.

activation_trace.role: Returning or sending back supplies an exploratory recoil latent inside the split mapping of the initiating will.
The repeated stratagem supplies the concrete item whose grammatical direction returns.
Reciprocal waiting supplies a prior example of an action being sent back to its initiators.

changed_reading.before: Their stable will launches a plan that is later countered.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory structural level, recoil is latent in the very launch: willing, waiting, and scheming enter a return-pattern that sends the operation back before its authors can stand outside it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy, surprising because it carries the rare slow-fire-stick branch of كيد into a verse about stratagem. It remains packet-anchored because the same branch is available at both 52:42 and the explicit recurrence of their ineffective كيد in 52:46. Downstream prose should label it as an image-bearing activation, never as the lexical meaning demanded by the syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus كيدا and المكيدون repeat a root whose inventory includes effortful, delayed fire-making.

activation_trace.role: A fire-stick slow to yield fire supplies the image of strenuous contrivance that cannot secure ignition.
The repeated slow-fire image joins explicit non-sufficiency to effort that never becomes useful flame.

changed_reading.before: Their clever plot is overturned by superior cleverness.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, they labor over tinder that never becomes useful flame; the repeated scheme's explicit non-sufficiency makes effort itself evidence of impotence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the death-throes branch of كيد rather than its ordinary plotting branch. It remains anchored by the focus root, its exact recurrence in 52:46, and the intervening encounter with a day of stunning or death. Downstream prose should qualify it as a terminal-energy analogy, not claim that كيد lexically means dying here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus doubles كيد and ends with a passive condition, allowing its struggle-at-departure branch to color the plot as expended agency.

activation_trace.role: Struggling as the soul departs supplies the image of agency spent in a terminal convulsion.
Being stunned or dead supplies the adjacent terminal horizon that activates the distant focus branch.
The same terminal-struggle image colors their explicitly useless scheme as expenditure rather than power.

changed_reading.before: The plot is an instrument of active power that later fails.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the plot is already a death-throe of agency: intense motion whose endpoint is not mastery but the exhaustion named by the passive and the sequel.

strongest_changes: The repeated أم chain recasts plotting as attempted authorship and control, then writes the would-be controllers into a passive role.
The sight-and-relabeling sequence turns كفر and كيد into an epistemic enclosure whose cover traps its users.
52:45-46 gives المكيدون a temporal endpoint: their own scheme remains present but has no sufficiency and receives no aid.
52:49 lets the plot be reread from its afterpart, exposing planners whose scouting never encompassed the consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supports several simultaneous reversals: tactical, grammatical, epistemic, temporal, authorial, and retrospective. The packet also sustains contained material outliers in which recoil, failed ignition, and terminal expenditure sharpen the same subject-to-object turn without replacing its ordinary plotting sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive counter-agent remains grammatically unexpressed; 52:48 supplies a governing frame but does not force a syntactic identification.
The external-counterplot, witnessed-governance, and retrospective-outcome models can coexist, but the packet does not specify whether one is causally primary.
The non-dominant ر د د mapping and the fire/death branches are deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory analogies.
